title: Omega Speedmaster: from racetrack to the Moon

slides.title: It was never meant to leave *Earth.*
slides.body: How a racing chronograph became the watch NASA chose for the Moon.

image.credit: Photo: Neil Armstrong / NASA · Public domain

slides.title: Born for the *racetrack*
slides.body: Omega launches the Speedmaster as a sports chronograph, with a **tachymeter scale on the bezel** to measure speed. Space isn't part of the plan.

slides.title: An unofficial *first flight*
slides.body: Astronaut Wally Schirra wears **his own Speedmaster** in orbit aboard Sigma 7. NASA hasn't chosen an official watch yet. But it's about to.

slides.title: The ultimate *torture test*
slides.body: NASA asks several brands for chronographs and puts them through **extreme heat and cold, vacuum, violent shocks and deafening noise.** One by one, they fail.

slides.title: Only one *survives*
slides.body: In March 1965 the Speedmaster is declared **flight-qualified for manned space missions.** Legend says Omega had no idea it was being tested. The records suggest otherwise.

slides.title: One small step for a *watch*
slides.body: Buzz Aldrin walks on the Moon wearing his Speedmaster. **Neil Armstrong left his inside the lunar module** as a backup, because its electronic timer had failed.

slides.title: The first watch worn on the Moon is *missing*
slides.body: Aldrin's Speedmaster was later sent to the Smithsonian. **It never made it**, and it has never been found. Perhaps the most famous watch in history, lost.

slides.title: The watch that brought them *home*
slides.body: On crippled Apollo 13, the crew times a **critical 14-second engine burn** with a Speedmaster. The astronauts later give Omega the Silver Snoopy Award.

slides.title: Today, it's simply called the *Moonwatch.*

caption:
It started as a racing chronograph. It ended up on the Moon. 🌕

In 1964 NASA put chronographs from several brands through heat, cold, vacuum and shock. Only the Omega Speedmaster survived. Five years later, Buzz Aldrin wore one on the lunar surface, and that watch has been missing ever since.

Which detail surprised you most? 👇
